title: CGM hardship approval and the restocking share on continence returns: Urology and Continence Supply Program
content:
A customer whose Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program carries an approved hardship application has the restocking basis relieved on straight-tip intermittent catheter (A4351) returns credited on a Continence Commercial HMO Program of the Urology and Continence Supply Program.

## Relief

- When the customer's Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program carries a hardship application that is approved and was received within the last 12 calendar months, the restocking basis is multiplied by one half (0.5).
- When the newest such approved application was received within the last 24 calendar months but not the last 12, the restocking basis is multiplied by three quarters (0.75).
- Otherwise the restocking basis is not changed.

The newest approved application is the approved hardship application with the latest received date on the Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program. "Within the last 12 calendar months" means received fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the credit date, and 24 months is read the same way.

## Cases (hypothetical; restocking basis 40.00 USD)

| Newest approved CGM hardship application received | Restocking basis |
|---|---|
| 8 months before the credit | 40.00 times 0.5, which is 20.00 USD |
| 18 months before the credit | 40.00 times 0.75, which is 30.00 USD |
| 30 months before the credit, or none | 40.00 USD, not changed |
